body:
This PR enables Link Time Optimization (LTO), configures more appropriate memory and stack limits, enables Asyncify and exception handling, and restores strict undefined-symbol checking to ensure missing dependencies are caught during linking. 

It also introduces a `wasm_stubs.c` implementation that provides Emscripten compatible replacements for a number of libuv and platform specific functions that are not available in a WASM environment.

comment_data.body:
this file looks specific to libuv, not Nvim, so ideally it would live in e.g. `src/wasm_stubs.c`

If we end up needing many such files, maybe we need a `src/wasm/` dir
this seems to be missing some logic in build.zig to actually include this file (when compiling with WASM target)?

does this intentionally follow some external style like libuv style?

If not, I'd suggest add this to `UNCRUSTIFY_NVIM_SOURCES` (below tee.c and xxd.c) in `src/nvim/CMakeLists.txt` and run `make formatc` for a consistent style.
Yeah, sorry. `wasm_stubs.c` is under `src/`, not `src/nvim/` now, so it wasn't being picked up. I will handle it.
